recentItems.description:
Enjoy the timeless melodies of Benazir (1964), a classic Hindi film featuring the legendary voices of Asha Bhosle, Lata Mangeshkar, Mohammed Rafi and Usha Mangeshkar. Experience the golden era of Bollywood music with beautiful compositions by the legendary music director S. D. Burman and memorable lyrics by Shakeel Badayuni.

Starring Ashok Kumar, Meena Kumari, Shashi Kapoor, Tanuja and Nirupa Roy, Benazir brings together classic Bollywood music and the charm of vintage Hindi cinema. This complete songs jukebox is perfect for fans of old Hindi songs, evergreen Bollywood melodies and the golden age of Indian film music.
